visualCharacteristics: Text next to an image/video (media left or right; media/text widths: widths-equal five-twelfths each, from 1920px a third each; media-wider half / third, from 1920px five-twelfths / quarter; text-wider third / half, from 1920px quarter / five-twelfths), stacked on phones; special intro (big headline) and special section (title left, text right, no media, optional 3-line clamp with "Mehr anzeigen")
contentPattern: Row 1 (optional, media): desktop image, mobile image[, tablet image] - or poster images + desktop/mobile video links. Row 2 (content): heading, paragraphs, CTAs (a CTA can link to a #layer-N layer section).
